hypothesis: An input-rank maximizing active policy produces >5 percentage points more correct held responses than budget-matched random do queries in a small tokenless GF(2) causal consequence family, without wrong confidently identified answers or additional effects.
source_authority: New independently authored synthetic fixed Boolean consequences only; no imports of CKAD public source generators, no original fixtures or protected source first-use, no owner original do/reset. This is fabricated development evidence NOT original-world scientific validation.

worlds.model_input: Six binary observed properties and a separate action bit; one128-input consequence world per seed
worlds.feature_grammar: Supplied degree<=2 binary subset polynomial terms for IN_FAMILY, 3 for SHIFT. Coefficients independently generated from SHA256 seeded term IDs, with deterministic action-interaction, at least five active terms. Each observed do(ctx,action) returns one binary parity consequence generated from world's private truth.

protocol.passive: Repeated input contexts from unmodified behavior policy action=(context & 1); draw deterministically with replacement from allowed input pool; no ability to force action, same24 observed-effect calls

SHUFFLED labels from per-world SHA frozen permutation on chosen inputs, before training but after selection, scored against original world; diagnostic only. thresholds.primary: Mean paired active-random correct held coverage gain>=5 percentage points over 32 IN_FAMILY worlds, paired world bootstrap95pct lower bound>0 with deterministic 1000 resamples; zero wrong among native identified responses and across all native held predictions
thresholds.additional: No worse effects than random. Active/passive contrast reported but not part of primary win, because passive actions cannot be forced.
thresholds.held_minimum: Active >=60% correct held coverage on average; cold exact across all worlds, checkpoint unchanged
thresholds.negative: SHIFT and SHUFFLED false-confidence and rejection rates explicitly reported; no acceptance claim if material wrong under shift, even if in-family passes
thresholds.science: Always false: invented supplied grammar, no truly unfamiliar original mechanism, and same-prior independent symbolic baseline.

stopping: One primary and one exact Windows replication; no retuning or seed/threshold/source changes after results; keep null/negative. No original owner source first-use.
